events.verdict: RAR shows Bridges (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball from Aldridge (SAS) in the post.
Bridges (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball before making incidental contact with Aldridge (SAS) during the steal.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) briefly grasps Aldridge's (SAS) jersey, but doesn't affect his ability to get to the pass.
Aldridge (SAS) makes clean contact with the ball during Oubre Jr.'s (PHX) prior to any incidental contact during the driving shot attempt.
Aldridge (SAS) makes contact with Oubre Jr.'s (PHX) head during rebounding that affects his ability to retrieve the ball.
Jackson (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball from Gay (SAS) prior to the pick.
During the loose ball, Jackson (PHX) grabs Gay's (SAS) shoulder and affects his ability to get to the ball.
Bertans (SAS) makes contact to the body of Jackson (PHX) during the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Bertans (SAS) makes marginal contact to Oubre Jr. (PHX) that doesn't affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) and Aldridge (SAS) engage in the paint. The contact is marginal and Aldridge loses his footing.
White (SAS) beats Booker (PHX) to the spot and absorbs the contact in the chest as Booker drives through his body and extends his arm to dislodge White.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) engages with Bertans (SAS) during the screen but he is able to move through contact.
Aldridge (SAS) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Jackson (PHX) and briefly grasps his arm during the screen but he is able to move through contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Belinelli (SAS) takes more than two steps after he has gathered the ball.
RLS shows Booker (PHX) makes contact to Belinelli's (SAS) arm, affecting his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Oubre Jr. (PHX) makes marginal contact to the arm of Gay (SAS) after his release and the contact doesn't affect his jump shot attempt or ability to follow-through naturally.
